from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
CHROME=r"C:\Program Files\Google\Chrome\Application\chrome.exe"
msgs=[]
with sync_playwright() as p:
    b=p.chromium.launch(executable_path=CHROME)
    pg=b.new_page(viewport={"width":1440,"height":900})
    pg.on("console", lambda m: msgs.append((m.type,m.text)))
    pg.on("pageerror", lambda e: msgs.append(("pageerror",str(e))))
    pg.goto("http://localhost:4173/", wait_until="networkidle"); pg.wait_for_timeout(500)

    # 1. the balance actually moves
    a=pg.locator(".balance-spin").screenshot(); pg.wait_for_timeout(180)
    c=pg.locator(".balance-spin").screenshot()
    print("balance moves:", a!=c)

    # 2. choose a finish from the card
    pg.get_by_role("button", name="Choose this finish").nth(1).click()
    pg.wait_for_timeout(1200)
    print("select value:", pg.locator("#config").input_value())
    print("ticket:", pg.locator(".ticket").inner_text().replace("\n"," | "))
    print("card selected:", pg.locator(".config.is-selected h3").inner_text())

    # 3. keyboard through the form and submit
    pg.fill("#name","Marguerite Roche"); pg.fill("#email","m.roche@example.ch")
    pg.get_by_role("button", name="Reserve a movement").last.click()
    pg.wait_for_timeout(400)
    print("CONFIRM:", pg.locator(".confirm").inner_text().replace("\n"," | "))
    pg.locator("#reserve").screenshot(path="C:/tmp/shots/confirm.png")

    # 4. power-path stage focus/hover state
    pg.goto("http://localhost:4173/#power-path"); pg.wait_for_timeout(900)
    st=pg.locator(".stage").nth(3)
    before=st.evaluate("e=>getComputedStyle(e).backgroundColor")
    st.hover(); pg.wait_for_timeout(250)
    print("stage hover changes:", before, "->", st.evaluate("e=>getComputedStyle(e).backgroundColor"))
    print("pulse anim:", pg.locator(".stage__node").first.evaluate("e=>getComputedStyle(e,'::after').animationName"))
    pg.close()

    # 5. reduced motion
    pg2=b.new_page(viewport={"width":1440,"height":900}, reduced_motion="reduce")
    pg2.goto("http://localhost:4173/", wait_until="networkidle"); pg2.wait_for_timeout(500)
    x=pg2.locator(".balance-spin").screenshot(); pg2.wait_for_timeout(300)
    y=pg2.locator(".balance-spin").screenshot()
    print("reduced-motion still:", x==y)
    print("section visible under reduced motion:",
          pg2.locator("#specification .specs").evaluate("e=>getComputedStyle(e).opacity"))
    pg2.close(); b.close()
print("CONSOLE", msgs)
EOF
